notes.title: FEROCIOUS New Trailer and Release Window
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]FEROCIOUS[/b] was part of [b][i]Find Your Next Game Show[/i][/b], Germany’s first major gaming showcase, live during [b]Gamescom[/b], where we revealed a [b]new exclusive trailer[/b] for the game, showing just some of the dangers standing between our protagonist, San,  and his goal to rescue his brother: giant crabs, swarms of leeches, deadly dinosaurs, aggressive Manifesto soldiers, and more. The island is not going to make it easy for you![/p][h3]
[b]If you haven’t, you check it out here:[/b]
[/h3][previewyoutube="SNYX9-K2e0s;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We also have another news for you: we’re aiming to[b] release FEROCIOUS this winter. [/b]We will be able to provide you a more precise date soon, but in the meantime thank you for following our journey so far, and we can’t wait to share more with you in the months ahead.[/p][p][/p][p][b]See you on the island![/b][/p][p][b][i]~the FEROCIOUS Dev Team[/i][/b][/p]
